---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability, improvement, or design direction for P5EMU
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

<!--
Please keep proposals grounded in the project's evidence and provenance
standards (see CONTRIBUTING.md). Do not request features that require Sony
firmware, keys, or copyrighted material.
-->

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do that P5EMU does not support yet? Describe the problem
before the solution.

## Proposed approach

What you would like to see. If it touches architecture, say which layer
(decoder, IR, interpreter, AArch64 backend, loader, HLE, runtime, GPU, tooling,
docs).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why you think the proposal is better.

## Evidence / prior art

If this draws on documented facts, observed behaviour, or prior art, cite it and
classify it (documented / observed / inferred / synthetic). If it is motivated by
another emulator, describe the *architecture* learned, not copied code.

## Scope

- [ ] Small / self-contained
- [ ] Medium (touches one subsystem)
- [ ] Large / architectural (needs a design discussion first)

## Are you offering to work on it?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] Maybe, with guidance
- [ ] No, just proposing
